pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Nyezhmetdinov-Rossolimo Attack: 3...a6?!
pages.notes: Plan 2 recaptured with dxc6 written so it could not be read and called the d-file open (half-open). Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview. Plan 3 (light-square play on d5, which the c6-pawn covers once White's light-squared bishop is gone) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-13.

pages.name: Sicilian: 2...Nc6 3.d3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 from a King's Indian Attack with the knight on f3 blocking the f-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...b5 with White's bishop on b5. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...b5 with White's bishop on b5. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.O-O
pages.notes: Plans wrote Bxc6 and ...b5 so they could not be read. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.O-O Nge7
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...Be7 and ...O-O with the knight still on e7. Rewrote plan 4 around ...Ng6; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.O-O Nge7 5.b3
pages.notes: Overview called b3 a light-squared fianchetto (Bb2 is the dark-squared bishop); plan 4 'neutralised' a light-squared bishop with ...b4 ideas. Fixed the overview and rewrote plan 4. Plan 3 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-13 (reviewer: first draft's c3 blocks the b2-bishop).

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.O-O Nge7 5.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote ...a6-b5 as one route into White's bishop. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.O-O Nge7 5.c3 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent the knight to g6 'to control f4, h4' as moves and gave Black a queenside majority after Bxc6, which the e7-knight recaptures. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Rossolimo, 3...e6 4.O-O Nge7 5.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 played c3 with the knight on c3; plans 2 and 4 wrote ...b5 into the bishop and f4/h4 as moves. Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Nimzowitsch, 4.Nc3 e6 5.Nxd5
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-11: plan 1 pressured a d5-pawn not yet there and claimed a c-file. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer: first draft's development did not bear on d5).
